description: Na₃CuO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.47 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.67 Å. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and one longer (1.79 Å) Cu-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Cu atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Cu octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Cu atom.
